readout_other: 50% paw withdrawal threshold (von Frey filaments, up-and-down method); Western blot and immunofluorescence for KCC2, CaMKIV, p-CREB, p-ERK1/2; H&E staining
direction_notes: LIFU stimulation of the L4-L5 spinal cord increased the 50% paw withdrawal threshold (reduced mechanical allodynia), increased KCC2 expression, and decreased CaMKIV and p-CREB expression relative to the sham-amplifier (LIFU-) group, consistent with reduced neuronal excitability; p-ERK1/2 was unaffected.
safety_notes: H&E staining of the L4-L5 spinal cord after LIFU treatment showed no swelling or nuclear fragmentation of neurons, neutrophil infiltration, or bleeding.

exposures.label: LIFU stimulation of the L4-L5 spinal cord in peripheral-nerve-injury rats

target.label: L4-L5 section of the spinal cord

timing.protocol_description: Parameters were as follows: sine pulse wave frequency, 4 MHz; duty cycle (DC), 20%; pulse repetition frequency (PRF), 0.8 KHz; irradiation intensity, 0.65 MPa; and treatment duration, 20 min/d for 4 weeks. LIFU stimulation was started on the third day after PNI surgery during the time range of 09:00-15:00.

source_quotes.n_subjects: 2.2. Grouping and Experimental Design. After 1 week of adaptation, all rats were randomly divided into four groups (10 per group): normal group, rats that received neither surgery nor treatment; sham group, rats in which nerves were exposed according to the PNI surgical method but not ligated; and LIFU− group and LIFU+ group, rats that received PNI surgery and LIFU stimulation in parallel, except that the ultrasound (US) amplifier was always turned of during treatment in the LIFU− group.

flags.reason: The paper labels this value 'irradiation intensity' but gives it in MPa (a pressure unit, not W/cm2); recorded as a pressure value with this unit/label mismatch flagged. Domain (free field vs in situ) is not stated, so placed in unspecified_domain.
Only duty cycle (20%) and PRF (0.8 kHz) are stated; pulse duration would require arithmetic and is not given directly, so left not_reported.

The paper gives 'treatment duration, 20 min/d' as a single daily continuous pulsed exposure; recorded as 1200 s under the assumption this is one uninterrupted sonication session rather than multiple discrete trains, since no separate train/inter-train structure is described.
Treatment is described as daily for 4 weeks but no explicit total session count is stated.
